| Deploy on Bunker. During your control phase, if you control Bunker with a Rebel, attempt to "blow away" Bunker as follows: Charges! Come On, Come On!: Draw two destiny. Add 3 to total for each Explosive Charge on Bunker. Move! Move! Move!: If total destiny &gt; 12, your characters here may relocate to Back Door for free, Bunker and Landing Platform (if on table) are "blown away," opponent loses 8 Force and this card is lost. || Deploy on Bunker. {{Errata hl|1=Once}} during your control phase, if you control Bunker with a Rebel, {{Errata hl|1=you may}} attempt to 'blow away' Bunker as follows: Charges! Come On, Come On!: Draw two destiny. Add 3 to total for each Explosive Charge on Bunker. Move! Move! Move!: If total destiny &gt; 12, your characters here may relocate to Back Door for free, Bunker and Landing Platform (if on table) are 'blown away,' opponent loses 8 Force and this card is lost.
